Confusing the WHO/WHAT plane. The article attacks the structural institution of surrogacy based on the private moral failings of a single individual.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.

The Unavoidable Truth: Private oversharing can indeed expose children to unnecessary instability and parental negligence.

The Unavoidable Lie: One individual's bizarre diary proves that all surrogate or LGBTQ families inherently sacrifice child welfare.
